_comment: Robot description for the simulator. Device names must match the Robot Controller configuration and the names in your code. Units: inches, degrees.

drivetrain._comment: Mecanum drive. wheel_diameter_mm 104 = goBILDA mecanum (AutoOp1 uses 41.8 ticks/inch, which matches 537.7 ticks on a 104 mm wheel). Measure track width (left-right wheel spacing) and wheelbase (front-back spacing) on your robot.

_hub_comment: How the Control Hub is PHYSICALLY mounted. If your code passes a different orientation to imu.initialize(), the simulated yaw will be wrong exactly the way it would be on the robot. This matches driver.java (logo RIGHT, USB UP).
